dedupe_keys.name: kalin spark utilities for cellular mobility data preparation

description: Kalin prepares spatiotemporal movement records for cellular-traffic and human-mobility analysis. The OMNILab repository publishes Scala and Spark jobs for splitting logs by day, filtering geographic ranges, removing redundant movement records and calculating geographic midpoints or radius of gyration. A documented 27-column schema describes web-request timing, cell identifiers, traffic and position fields for a 19-day Hangzhou and Wenzhou source covering August and October 2012. Other jobs target Senegal D4D inputs. Software coverage follows the supplied traces; those private or separately distributed datasets are not claimed as a complete public release here. Archived code is free under Apache 2.0 and builds with sbt. A limitation is its old Spark-era dependencies and ambiguous longitude/latitude labels in the source-data dictionary. Simulation uses include creating movement summaries and flow inputs from telecommunications observations. No related catalogue resource was identified as this utility package. The linked C2TM dataset is being checked separately. Example log files and personal identifiers were not read, and no pipeline or build was executed.
